EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_STEP_10_TITLE: Keep your plants warmed up even in the harshest of circumstances!
EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_STEP_11_TITLE: Think ahead and plan accordingly as the switching sliders shall spin your world around once more!
EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_STEP_12_TITLE: Show the new chief who's boss by knocking down this hypothermic hero to absolute zero!
EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_STEP_13_TITLE: These yodeling adversaries are prepared to pop right through your defenses!
EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_STEP_14_TITLE: Flowers still have the will to live despite all odds. Defend them at all costs!
EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_STEP_15_TITLE: Take the tribe down a peg or two in this numbingly cold last stand!
EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_STEP_16_TITLE: Higher order has caught wind of your interference.
EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_STEP_17_TITLE: Boost your foes with the help of these intimidating presences in this tricky turn of events!
EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_STEP_18_TITLE: Ensure your plants can make it through this perilous blizzard!
EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_STEP_19_TITLE: Adapt to this harrowing environment with an unconventional game plan!
EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_STEP_1_TITLE: Step back into the hostile tundra as the hollows beckon upon you.
EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_STEP_20_TITLE: Team up with an unlikely ally to take back the hollows from Dr. Zomboss in this catastrophic finale!
EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_STEP_2_TITLE: Fleeting ice floes are getting warmed up for some redirectional chicanery!
EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_STEP_3_TITLE: Huddle up with a new, fiery ally! Capable of burning up to low and high altitudes!
EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_STEP_4_TITLE: Put Flameweed's hidden ferocity to the test by burning zombies into a crisp!
EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_STEP_5_TITLE: These barbaric hunters are ready to throw hands and snowballs towards your defenses!
EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_STEP_6_TITLE: Pepper-pults sure can stand the cold, but can they persist through the harsher environment?
EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_STEP_7_TITLE: A new opponent shall bring a whole new meaning to "don't fight fire with fire"!
EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_STEP_8_TITLE: Between the fire and frost, find a way in-between to take down these charred deadbeats!
EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_STEP_9_TITLE: Howls from the cave grow ever louder as new foes join in to blow through the crowd!
ESCAPEROOT_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}tap Escape Root and another plant to swap them
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}can't swap with endangered plants

{FLAVOR}The other plants put on a big surprise party for Escape Root last week, but he did his thing and suddenly it was a surprise party... FOR THEM!
ESCAPEROOT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Escape Roots explode upon being crushed, and can be swapped with other plants that are in danger.
ESCAPEROOT_TOOLTIP: Sturdy and can be swapped with other plants
EVENTS_HINT_1: Having trouble? Boosts from the Zen Garden can help you defeat hordes!
EVENTS_HINT_2: If a level is becoming too troubling, be sure to obtain more powerful plants!
EVENTS_HINT_3: Remember to bring plants that suit the threats you're facing!
EXIT_DANGER_ROOM_BODY: Are you sure that you want to leave? Doing so will reset the current level layout.
EXPLODEONUT_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}"My only regret," says Explode-O-Nut, "is that I have but one chewy center full of nitroglycerine to give in defense of this lawn."
EXPLODEONUT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Explode-O-Nuts provide protection, and when their shells are eaten, they explode to blow up zombies.
EXPLODEOVINE_DESCRIPTION:
{FLAVOR}
Explode-O-Vine is sooooooooooooooo ready to explode. Just ridiculously ready. He's got the color picked out and everything.
EXPLODEOVINE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Explode-O-Vines can be planted on top of other plants to provide protection, detonate an explosion with knockback when planted, and then another explosion when eaten.
EXPLODEOVINE_TOOLTIP: Protects a plant inside, explodes and knocks back

FINISH_BEACH_11_DESC: Bowling Bulb rolls bulbs down rows to bop, bounce and bash multiple zombies! Complete Big Wave Beach Day 11!
FINISH_BEACH_16_DESC: Abolish the atrocious Gargantuar of Big Wave Beach Day 16 to earn yourself a dandy Frostbite Caves Key!
FINISH_BEACH_19_DESC: Guacodile shoots, swims, and charges forward on defeat! REVENGE! Complete Big Wave Beach Day 19!
FINISH_BEACH_1_DESC: It's no day at the beach without Lily Pads! They let you plant on water! Complete Big Wave Beach Day 1!
FINISH_BEACH_20_DESC: TIKI-TORCHER! Paste perennial partying zombies and earn rewards in this beachside bash! Complete Big Wave Beach Day 20!
FINISH_BEACH_27_DESC: Banana Launcher dispenses justice by launching missiles anywhere on the board! Complete Big Wave Beach Day 27!
FINISH_BEACH_32_DESC: Quash the querulous Dr. Zomboss and earn your trophy in this surfing struggle on Big Wave Beach Day 32!
FINISH_BEACH_35_DESC: Chomper's teeth are so sharp, they make the sharks jealous! Complete Big Wave Beach Day 35!
FINISH_BEACH_37_DESC: Don’t let the outrageous Gargantuars ruin your groove, and surf on! Overcome the onslaught on Big Wave Beach Day 37!
FINISH_BEACH_37_TITLE: Overcome the onslaught in Big Wave Beach Expansion!
FINISH_BEACH_38_DESC: Homing Thistle tells every zombie before piercing them that "Thistle only hurt a little." Complete Big Wave Beach Day 38!
FINISH_BEACH_42_DESC: This fight might not seem quite as advertised! Make sure not to get yourself catfished! Complete Big Wave Beach Day 42!
FINISH_BEACH_6_DESC: Run silent, run deep. Tangle Kelp drags marine zombies to a watery grave! Complete Big Wave Beach Day 6!
FINISH_CARNIVAL_10_DESC: Blow away the zombies with a fleet of explosive balloons! Complete Caliginous Carnival Night 10!
FINISH_CARNIVAL_16_DESC: Strongarm the Strongman Gargantuar and earn yourself a time-leaping World Key! Complete Caliginous Carnival Night 16!
FINISH_CARNIVAL_19_DESC: Tiger Grass will jump out to slash oncoming zombies! Viewer discretion is advised! Complete Caliginous Carnival Night 19!
FINISH_CARNIVAL_1_DESC: Chip out little damage to those nasty zombies, one chip at a time! Complete Caliginous Carnival Night 1!
FINISH_CARNIVAL_20_DESC: TEST OF MIGHT: Prove your strength by pulling through this unrelenting performance! Complete Caliginous Carnival Night 20!
FINISH_CARNIVAL_23_DESC: Magic-shroom fires cards and can be tapped to pick a special card! What a play! Complete Caliginous Carnival Night 23!
FINISH_CARNIVAL_26_DESC: The Great Zucchini conjures a magic trick that sends zombies back to basics when tapped! You'll need to see it to believe it! Complete Caliginous Carnival Night 26!
FINISH_CARNIVAL_32_DESC: Put on a show against Dr. Zomboss and earn your trophy in this star-studded final act on Caliginous Carnival Night 32!
FINISH_CARNIVAL_4_DESC: Sap away zombies' agility with the one and only Caramel Popcorn! Dish out small damage with a chance of a huge splash of sap! Complete Caliginous Carnival Night 4!
FINISH_COWBOY_11_DESC: Sun Shovel! Get an additional 25% of sun cost back when shoveling up plants! Complete Wild West Day 11!
FINISH_COWBOY_12_DESC: Melon-pult flings heavy damage melons down a lane, hitting groups of zombies! Complete Wild West Day 12!
FINISH_COWBOY_15_DESC: Wall-nut First Aid: Fully repair damaged defensive plants by planting on top of them! Complete Wild West Day 15!
FINISH_COWBOY_18_DESC: Tall-Nut totally frustrates flying and hopping zombies! Serves 'em right! Complete Wild West Day 18!
FINISH_COWBOY_1_DESC: Sneaky zombies creeping up from behind? Split Pea shoots forward AND back! Complete Wild West Day 1!
FINISH_COWBOY_20_DESC: Instant Recharge: Instantly refresh a seed packet by dragging and dropping Plant Food on it! Complete Wild West Day 20!
FINISH_COWBOY_24_DESC: Winter Melon hits groups of zombies, deals heavy damage AND chills them out! Complete Wild West Day 24!
FINISH_COWBOY_25_DESC: Attack the awful Dr. Zomboss and earn your trophy in this desert duel on Wild West Day 25!
FINISH_COWBOY_28_DESC: Recapture the true authenticity of a western town with some Tumbleweeds! Complete Wild West Day 28!
FINISH_COWBOY_29_DESC: A duel at high noon's not something zombies will ever win! Overcome the onslaught on Wild West Day 29!
FINISH_COWBOY_29_TITLE: Overcome the onslaught in Wild West Expansion!
FINISH_COWBOY_31_DESC: Fry entire rows of zombies by testing your aim with Ultomato’s cart combos! Complete Wild West Day 31!
FINISH_COWBOY_35_DESC: Earn the title of a Sheriff and take down Zomboss! Complete Wild West Day 35!
FINISH_COWBOY_3_DESC: BIG BAD BUTTE! Engage endless zombies and earn rewards in this frontier fracas! Complete Wild West Day 3!
FINISH_COWBOY_4_DESC: Chili Bean destroys a zombie and stuns the group behind it! Complete Wild West Day 4!
FINISH_COWBOY_6_DESC: Pile up Pea Pods for massive firepower! Complete Wild West Day 6!
FINISH_COWBOY_8_DESC: Crush the monstrous Gargantuar of Wild West Day 8 to earn a time-tearing Far Future Key!
FINISH_COWBOY_9_DESC: Lightning Reed shocks multiple foes at high speeds and adjacent lanes! Great for frying chickens! Complete Wild West Day 9!
FINISH_DARK_10_DESC: Maul the medieval Gargantuar of Dark Ages Night 10 to earn yet another impossible Big Wave Beach Key!
FINISH_DARK_12_DESC: ARTHUR'S CHALLENGE! Punish primitive zombies to earn rewards in a forever feudal feud! Complete Dark Ages Day 12!
FINISH_DARK_15_DESC: Ug, metal! So annoying! Attract buckets and helmets away with Magnet Shroom! Complete Dark Ages Day 15!
FINISH_DARK_1_DESC: Cheap lil' Sun-shrooms emit ever-growing piles of sun! Radiant! Complete Dark Ages Day 1!
FINISH_DARK_20_DESC: Hamper the heinous Dr. Zomboss and earn your trophy in this tenth-century titlecard on Dark Ages Day 20!
FINISH_DARK_23_DESC: Employ magical spores to get zombies fighting on your side! Unlock Hypno-shroom on Dark Ages Night 23!
FINISH_DARK_25_DESC: Face the medieval attack brought upon you by Zomboss’s heinous execution warrant! Overcome the onslaught on Dark Ages Night 25!
FINISH_DARK_25_TITLE: Overcome the onslaught in Dark Ages Expansion!
FINISH_DARK_27_DESC: What's a horde of mushrooms without a little witchcraft to multiply the numbers? Unlock Witch Hazel on Dark Ages Night 27!
FINISH_DARK_2_DESC: How about a quick little shooter that costs ZERO sun? Puff-shroom it is! Complete Dark Ages Day 2!
FINISH_DARK_30_DESC: Slay the wicked dragon brought back through unhallowed means and bring peace unto thy land! Complete Dark Ages Night 30!
FINISH_DARK_4_DESC: Fume-shroom sprays all zombies in an area. Take that, clumps of zombies! Complete Dark Ages Day 4!
FINISH_DARK_6_DESC: What if zombies spat out sun as they took damage? Sun Bean makes it happen! Complete Dark Ages Day 6!
FINISH_DINO_16_DESC: Annihilate the antediluvian Gargantuars of Jurassic Marsh Day 16 to earn a shiny Modern Day Key!
FINISH_DINO_17_DESC: Primal Sunflowers emit big, big suns! Complete Jurassic Marsh Day 17!
FINISH_DINO_1_DESC: Primal Peashooters sling serious smack with heavy, stunning peas! Complete Jurassic Marsh Day 1!
FINISH_DINO_20_DESC: LA BRAINSA TARPITS! Face dinosaurs and prehistoric zombies in this bygone battle! Complete Jurassic Marsh Day 20!
FINISH_DINO_23_DESC: Blast zombies with starchy goodness, courtesy of the Primal Potato Mine! Complete Jurassic Marsh Day 23!
FINISH_DINO_32_DESC: Frustrate the feverish Dr. Zomboss and earn your trophy in the swampy strife of Jurassic Marsh, Day 32!
FINISH_DINO_35_DESC: Slick your hair back with tar, as an explosively alluring Hot Date awaits you! Complete Jurassic Marsh Day 35!
FINISH_DINO_39_DESC: Bring claw and order to an age of barbarianism by electing Parnsip! Complete Jurassic Marsh Day 39!
FINISH_DINO_40_DESC: Tar can’t slow you down! Show these primordial Gargantuars that Dr. Zomboss’ plans are about to go extinct! Overcome the onslaught on Jurassic Marsh Day 40!
FINISH_DINO_40_TITLE: Overcome the onslaught in Jurassic Marsh Expansion!
FINISH_DINO_43_DESC: Hocus Crocus will make a zombie disappear in her next act, and she'll need some mandatory volunteers! Complete Jurassic Marsh Day 43!
FINISH_DINO_48_DESC: A fossil once will be a fossil again! Complete Jurassic Marsh Day 48!
FINISH_DINO_4_DESC: Build up defenses quickly with the fast-planting Primal Wall-nut! Complete Jurassic Marsh Day 4!
FINISH_DINO_8_DESC: Charm dinosaurs and sic 'em on the zombies with Perfume-shroom! Complete Jurassic Marsh Day 8!
FINISH_EGYPT_12_DESC: PYRAMID OF DOOM! Bash zombies for rewards in this endless Egyptian survival mode! Complete Ancient Egypt Day 12!
FINISH_EGYPT_13_DESC: Bonk Choy: this pugilisitic plant beats zombies up AND backwards! Complete Ancient Egypt Day 13!
FINISH_EGYPT_17_DESC: Plant Food Slot: hold onto one more Plant Food during a level! Always handy! Complete Ancient Egypt Day 17!
FINISH_EGYPT_19_DESC: Why shoot one pea when you can shoot two for twice the firepower with Repeater? Complete Ancient Egypt Day 19!
FINISH_EGYPT_21_DESC: Starting Sun Boost: start your day right with 25 extra sun in the bank every level! Complete Ancient Egypt Day 21!
FINISH_EGYPT_24_DESC: Sun-starved? Twin Sunflowers burp up twice the sun per square! Complete Ancient Egypt Day 24!
FINISH_EGYPT_25_DESC: Defeat the diabolical Dr. Zomboss and earn your trophy in this bygone battle on Ancient Egypt Day 25!
FINISH_EGYPT_27_DESC: Nasty torches burning defenses? Extinguish the fiery nuisances with Snow Pea! Complete Ancient Egypt Day 27!
FINISH_EGYPT_29_DESC: Prove that Gargantuar Pharaohs are nothing but a bunch of phonies! Overcome the onslaught on Ancient Egypt Day 29!
FINISH_EGYPT_29_TITLE: Overcome the onslaught in Ancient Egypt Expansion!
FINISH_EGYPT_2_DESC: Lob cabbages over gravestones for a long-distance surprise! Complete Ancient Egypt Day 2!
FINISH_EGYPT_31_DESC: If you ever wished your problems could just be squished away, wish no more! Unlock Squash on Ancient Egypt Day 31!
FINISH_EGYPT_35_DESC: Defeat the uncanny resurrection of a bygone adversary on Ancient Egypt Day 35!
FINISH_EGYPT_3_DESC: Whip boomerangs through several foes at once for double-dealing damage! Complete Ancient Egypt Day 3!
FINISH_EGYPT_5_DESC: Iceberg Lettuce freezes zombies in their tracks! So cool! Complete Ancient Egypt Day 5!
FINISH_EGYPT_7_DESC: Play more Ancient Egypt levels to unlock more plants!
FINISH_EGYPT_8_DESC: Defeat the hideous Gargantuar of Ancient Egypt Day 8 to earn a time-leaping Pirate Seas Key!
FINISH_EGYPT_9_DESC: Crumble gravestones instantly with Grave Buster! Complete Ancient Egypt Day 9!
FINISH_EIGHTIES_16_DESC: Mangle the musical Gargantuar of Neon Mixtape Tour Day 16 to earn a righteous Jurassic Marsh Key!
FINISH_EIGHTIES_17_DESC: Use Garlic for all your lane-diversion needs! Complete Neon Mixtape Tour Day 17!
FINISH_EIGHTIES_1_DESC: Phat Beet brings the rhythm and doles out damage all around! Complete Neon Mixtape Tour Day 1!
FINISH_EIGHTIES_20_DESC: GREATEST HITS: Rap rhythmic zombies and earn rewards in this melodic mashup! Complete Neon Mixtape Tour Day 20!
FINISH_EIGHTIES_21_DESC: Spore-shrooms make more-shrooms! Complete Neon Mixtape Tour Day 21!
FINISH_EIGHTIES_26_DESC: Revive eaten plants with the indomitable Intensive Carrot! Complete Neon Mixtape Tour Day 26!
FINISH_EIGHTIES_32_DESC: Irritate the irascible Dr. Zomboss and earn your trophy in the operatic onslaught of Neon Mixtape Tour 32!
FINISH_EIGHTIES_35_DESC: Electric blues touch the hearts of zombies everywhere, but Electric Blueberry stops them instead! Complete Neon Mixtape Tour Day 35!
FINISH_EIGHTIES_37_DESC: Keep your party private and show these mediocre musicians that they’re not invited! Overcome the onslaught on Neon Mixtape Tour Day 37!
FINISH_EIGHTIES_37_TITLE: Overcome the onslaught in Neon Mixtape Tour Expansion!
FINISH_EIGHTIES_38_DESC: Give the zombies something to chew on with Gumnut's troublesome bubblegum! Complete Neon Mixtape Tour Day 38!
FINISH_EIGHTIES_42_DESC: Deliver Dr. Zomboss this simple message through the power of music: We're not gonna take it! Complete Neon Mixtape Tour Day 42!
FINISH_EIGHTIES_5_DESC: Sneaky Celery Stalker hides underground, then pops up to smack zombies from behind! Complete Neon Mixtape Tour Day Day 5!
FINISH_EIGHTIES_9_DESC: Want to rewind zombies back to their starting position? Then let's do the Thyme Warp again! Complete Neon Mixtape Tour Day 9!
FINISH_FAIRYTALE_12_DESC: Is it an imp? Or is it a reflection of something much more sinister? Complete Fairytale Forest Day 12!
FINISH_FAIRYTALE_14_DESC: Coffee Bean wakes plants from slumber and gives them a speed boost! Complete Fairytale Forest Day 14!
FINISH_FAIRYTALE_18_DESC: Haze-shroom helps you dispel magic from both plants and zombies, all while growing stronger! Complete Fairytale Forest Day 18!
FINISH_FAIRYTALE_1_DESC: Hatter-shroom fires hats that ricochet off zombies! Time to throw your hat into the ring! Complete Fairytale Forest Day 1
FINISH_FAIRYTALE_22_DESC: THE NEVERENDING STORY: Don't lose yourself amidst its never-ending pages, and bookmark how long you can endure this hero's journey! Complete Fairytale Forest Day 22!
FINISH_FAIRYTALE_25_DESC: It's time to see this story to its end, and slay the terrible dragon! Can our heroes triumph over the evil wizard? Complete Fairytale Forest Night 25!
FINISH_FAIRYTALE_4_DESC: Spring Princess lobs springs that throw zombies back. Let's hop to it! Complete Fairytale Forest Day 4!
FINISH_FAIRYTALE_7_DESC: Ent may be prickly, but he's durable to zombie bites and heals himself when unoccupied! Complete Fairytale Forest Day 7!
FINISH_FUTURE_13_DESC: Infi-Nut regenerates over time and blocks all rows with Plant Food! Astounding! Complete Far Future Day 13!
FINISH_FUTURE_17_DESC: Fun with Sun! Spend sun on powerful blasts with Magnifying Grass. Complete Far Future Day 17!
FINISH_FUTURE_1_DESC: Laser Bean's gaze pierces all zombies on a lane with each shot! ZAP! Complete Far Future Day 1!
FINISH_FUTURE_20_DESC: Mower Launcher: manually launch one mower by tapping and holding! Clear 'em out! Complete Far Future Day 20!
FINISH_FUTURE_24_DESC: Power Tiles boost your Plant Food effects. Create 'em with Tile Turnip! Complete Far Future Day 24!
FINISH_FUTURE_25_DESC: Deny the devious Dr. Zomboss and earn your trophy in this someday struggle on Far Future Day 25!
FINISH_FUTURE_27_DESC: Combat the futuristic contraptions and create your own fighters with Zoybean Pod! Complete Far Future Day 27!
FINISH_FUTURE_29_DESC: Save Dave from the knave technological slave or else he'll face a robotic grave! Overcome the onslaught on Far Future Day 29!
FINISH_FUTURE_29_TITLE: Overcome the onslaught in Far Future Expansion!
